page_title: STU 4-0 HAM | Stuttgart v Hamburger SV 12/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Stuttgart are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Great teamplay by Hamburger SV as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
88' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Deniz Undav is replaced by Jeremy Arevalo (VfB Stuttgart).
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lorenz Assignon trots off the pitch and is replaced by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart).

86' 4 - 0 Goal! Tiago Tomas passes the ball to Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Daniel Heuer Fernandes couldn't do anything about it. 4:0.
84' Hamburger SV get a corner.
82' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) misses the penalty! His poor effort goes well over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
82' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is going to take the penalty!
81' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
81' Referee Sven Jablonski makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
80' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to discuss the decision with Sven Jablonski, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
80' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Sven Jablonski's book.
78' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Stuttgart for a penalty. Play continues.
76' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) for Daniel Elfadli.
72' That's the end of the game for Fabio Balde, who is replaced by Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger).
70' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Chema Andres.
70' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Chris Fuhrich.
70' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Ermedin Demirovic will be replaced by Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart).
69' The Stuttgart players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
68' Celebrations are cut short for Stuttgart as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
67' The Stuttgart players halt their celebrations as referee Sven Jablonski makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
66' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) gets on the end of a delightful cross and sends the ball inside the right post!
66' Hamburger SV are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
63' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) produces a good strike that sails towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
60' Here is a change. Rayan Philippe is going off and Merlin Polzin gives the last tactical orders to Otto Stange (Hamburger).
60' The substitution has been made. Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) has replaced Albert Gronbaek.
60' Stuttgart work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

59' A truly beautiful footballing moment. Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) takes the free kick from a very promising position, but the goalkeeper thwarts the effort with an amazing save. The ball goes out for a corner. Stuttgart can continue in their attacking effort.
56' 3 - 0 Goal! Chris Fuhrich slips it to Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom left corner with a great effort. The score is 3:0.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart.
54' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) is unable to keep his close-range header down and sends the cross from Fabio Balde just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.

53' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Daniel Heuer Fernandes makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
52' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.

50' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) blows a huge opportunity after receiving a cross from the free kick. He shoots from just outside of the box, but the ball goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
50' Warmed Omari (Hamburger) makes a slide tackle, but referee Sven Jablonski blows for a foul. Stuttgart will take a free kick.
48' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
48' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
48' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) jumps into a tackle and Sven Jablonski signals a foul.
46' Hamburger SV keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. The ball is out of play. Stuttgart will take a throw-in.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

44' Stuttgart are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
41' Good work from Stuttgart as they win a corner.
40' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' CLOSE! Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
38' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
38' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
36' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) and Jeff Chabot matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
36' Neat passing move from Stuttgart in order to create new attacking opportunities.
35' The Hamburger SV players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

32' 2 - 0 Ermedin Demirovic is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom right corner to make the score 2:0.
32' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:3.
28' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) takes the corner.

28' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Alexander Nubel guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save. It will be a corner kick for Hamburger SV.
27' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
27' Hamburger SV control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
24' Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.

21' 1 - 0 Goal! Jamie Leweling shows great vision to find Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
21' The ball possession at the moment is 71:29.
21' The Stuttgart players are exchanging some short passes.
19' The ball is cleared after Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

18' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is behind the touchline and Hamburger SV will take a throw-in.

16' Fabio Balde (Hamburger) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
15' Stuttgart take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
14' A player from Stuttgart commits a rough challenge. Sven Jablonski blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
12' Hamburger SV are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
10' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) hits a good looking first-time shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
8' Stuttgart seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
7' A corner kick by Stuttgart is thwarted by the well prepared Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger).
6' Stuttgart can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Stuttgart have a corner.
4' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) sends a cross into the box, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes comes off his line to gather the ball.
2' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Stuttgart will have the kick-off.
Sven Jablonski got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
